headline: Continued public hearing on LDR-26-11, Act 250 Tier 1A review of conditions, plus landscaping rules and housing mix changes.
summary: The meeting picks up a continued hearing on Act 250 Tier 1A conditions. It also covers possible changes to landscaping rules, long-term care facilities, commercial building scale, and housing types.
items: Continued public hearing on LDR Amendment LDR-26-11: Act 250 Tier 1A review of conditions process
Landscaping regulations update: landscaping requirements, landscaping budget, and civic space in commercial areas
Long-term care facilities, scale of commercial uses, and mix of housing types: further discussion of possible changes
Notice of draft amendments to the Williston Unified Development Bylaw, for November 17, 2026 at 7:00 PM
